zh.title: 巴基斯坦Gwadar：Ormara海岸公路客车与LPG罐车相撞致10死27伤
zh.summary: 11月19日，Makran Coastal Highway的Basol—Ormara路段发生客车与液化石油气罐车相撞起火事故。警方确认10人死亡；后续报道列出27人受伤，事故导致公路中断数小时。
zh.region: 巴基斯坦 / Balochistan / Gwadar / Ormara
zh.body:
事实：11月19日，一辆从Turbat驶往Karachi的客车在Gwadar地区Ormara附近Basol路段与LPG罐车相撞，两车起火。Dawn引述Makran Coastal Highway警方负责人Muhammad Aslam Bangulzai确认至少10人死亡、多人烧伤，道路中断数小时；Hum English后续引述警方报告27人受伤。事故发生在N-10海岸公路，与Chagai/Nok Kundi的N-40不属于同一路段。
分析与判断：这起事故直接暴露危险品运输与客运车辆混行的高后果碰撞风险。当地今年已发生多起严重道路事故，反映该走廊的行车行为、危险品运输管理与医疗救援能力值得项目方重新审视。警方调查将决定事故责任，现阶段应将其归类为重大交通安全及短时物流中断事件，而非武装袭击。对Gwadar、Ormara、Pasni、Turbat及Karachi间开展人员和货物运输的企业，最直接的影响是行程时间、车辆类型选择、应急医疗转运与危险品交会风险；目前报道仅确认事发时封路数小时，后续恢复状态应以当地交警实时公告为准。
行动参考：涉及N-10的出行计划核对当天通行公告和事故路段位置，要求承运商提供车辆技术状态、驾驶员工时与危险品隔离安排；对Ormara—Pasni段的长途行程设置医疗转运联系人及备用停靠点。后续观察三项指标：警方事故原因认定、N-10通行与清障公告、受伤人员最终统计及对客运/危险品运输监管的调整。
来源：https://www.dawn.com/news/2045668；https://humenglish.com/latest/10-killed-27-injured-as-bus-collides-with-lpg-tanker-on-makran-coastal-highway/

en.title: Pakistan Gwadar: Ten killed and 27 injured in Ormara coastal highway LPG tanker crash
en.summary: On 19 November, a passenger coach collided with an LPG tanker near Basol and Ormara on the Makran Coastal Highway, causing a fire that killed ten people and reportedly injured 27. Traffic was suspended for several hours.
en.body:
Facts: On 19 November, a passenger coach travelling from Turbat to Karachi collided with an LPG tanker near Basol in the Ormara area of Gwadar district. Both vehicles caught fire. Dawn cited Makran Coastal Highway police chief Muhammad Aslam Bangulzai confirming at least ten deaths, burn injuries and a highway closure lasting several hours. Hum English subsequently reported 27 injured, citing police. The N-10 coastal highway is geographically distinct from the N-40 route through Chagai and Nok Kundi.
Assessment: This is a high-consequence road transport incident involving mixed passenger and hazardous-material traffic. Repeated severe crashes on this corridor make driver conduct, hazardous cargo movement and medical response capability relevant operational concerns. The cause remains under police investigation; the incident is classified as transport safety and temporary logistics disruption, not an armed attack. Companies moving staff and freight between Gwadar, Ormara, Pasni, Turbat and Karachi face exposure through journey delays, vehicle selection, emergency evacuation arrangements and interaction with LPG tankers. Reports establish several hours of closure at the time, not an ongoing highway shutdown.
Operational response: Check current N-10 traffic notices and the precise incident location before dispatch; review contractor vehicle condition, driver hours and hazardous cargo separation practices; identify medical transfer contacts and alternate safe stops for the Ormara–Pasni section. Track three verifiable indicators: police findings on crash causation, official road clearance and reopening notices, and final casualty figures or regulatory changes affecting coach and tanker operations.
Sources: https://www.dawn.com/news/2045668; https://humenglish.com/latest/10-killed-27-injured-as-bus-collides-with-lpg-tanker-on-makran-coastal-highway/
